known_issues.what: AI4Privacy fragments of one source document (ids differing only by letter suffix) were grouped separately, so 34 numeric parents with 80 rows cross tuning and test in the release, and 3 parents with 7 rows in the selected first-benchmark subset (test [AI4Privacy id], [AI4Privacy id], [AI4Privacy id], [AI4Privacy id]; tuning [AI4Privacy id], [AI4Privacy id], [AI4Privacy id]). Text runs on across the split for [AI4Privacy id]/B and [AI4Privacy id]/B.
known_issues.consequence: PII test rows are not independent held-out documents. Primary scores unchanged; see sensitivity view pii-independent-documents.

known_issues.what: AI4Privacy rows with empty privacy_mask were labelled negative. One blind AI review of all 450 PII negatives, then a second blind review of 63 of them (43 the first review marked present or unclear, plus 20 absent controls), marked 20 as containing a supported entity in both reviews; the other 387 rows had one review (dataset/frozen/corrections/pii-negatives-2026-09-24.jsonl): 3 selected test rows, 3 selected tuning rows, 14 unselected.
known_issues.consequence: Some false flags on those rows are reference errors; two tuning rows may have affected thresholds. Primary scores unchanged; see sensitivity view pii-disputed-negatives.
known_issues.fix: next version carries the audited label beside the original

known_issues.what: All 450 Gandalf rows (80 selected test) are mapped to subtask leakage. The source selects instruction-override attempts by embedding similarity and has no per-row leakage label.
known_issues.consequence: Treat as a noisy source-selected attack proxy; no leakage-specific claim. See sensitivity view attacks-without-gandalf.

known_issues.what: 32 of 240 selected content test positives map in our taxonomy to PII (21) or TOPIC (11) rather than the five content categories.
known_issues.consequence: Content measures agreement with the sources' policies, not only the five content filters. See sensitivity view content-five-categories and the per-category breakdown.

known_issues.what: AI4Privacy text is withheld (ids-only) but its span annotations and derived labels remain in the package; the upstream licence restricts redistribution and derivatives.
known_issues.consequence: Not cleared for upload; withheld from the publication staging until a distribution basis is documented.
